bodyObservations.observation: Consumes two 64-bit words and returns only the second as long; does not establish lossless 128-bit mapping.
Writes a zero word before the supplied long; server signedness and full-width semantics remain unverified.
Finite default DateTime read applies local conversion and a fixed eight-hour subtraction; not adopted as the new driver time contract.
Public Version property derives from parsed startup server_version, not an independently verified full Kingbase product build query.
